name: htmlbin
description: Agent-first HTML hosting. Drop HTML, get a URL. htmlbin.dev

scripts.db:migrate:local: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply htmlbin-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply htmlbin-db --remote
scripts.db:migrate:list:local: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations list htmlbin-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:list:remote: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations list htmlbin-db --remote
